fit: first visual hallucination in a Parkinson cohort without food exposure
assessment: Thirty-one of 63 followed patients reported incident visual hallucinations. Table 2 estimates an adjusted odds ratio of 1.027 per Brief Fatigue Inventory point. The outcome is onset rather than episodes per patient, without eating dried fig data.

fit: qualitatively described rest tremor in a Parkinson case
assessment: A patient with Parkinson disease and camptocormia had slight resting tremor. The case does not report a tremor severity comparison or dietary turkey. Turkey in the affiliation is a country.

fit: posture-linked pain in a Parkinson case during spine and stimulation care
assessment: This patient had low-back pain from moderate to severe along with lumbar disease and camptocormia. Pain improvement followed stimulation in a single case with no isolated date or dietary contrast.

fit: rest tremor described in two parkinsonian Lewy body cases
assessment: The original case series describes rest tremor in two of five parkinsonian cases. It does not supply standardized severity or an edible fig exposure.

fit: rest tremor in six cases with a typical parkinsonian syndrome
assessment: In the early Lewy body series, all six patients presenting with typical parkinsonism had rest tremor. The original does not measure severity after exposure to raw fig.

fit: fresh date extract and open-field exploration in Sprague-Dawley rats
assessment: Open-field travel and rearing were greater than with diabetic vehicle. The study reports a differing strain and group design from the earlier Wistar paper. Nociception and locomotor task performance do not measure apathy in Parkinson disease.

fit: aqueous fresh date extract and open-field exploration in Wistar rats
assessment: Movement and rearing were greater than in diabetic sham rats (p<.05). Grooming remained reduced relative to healthy controls. The study concerns an extract and induced peripheral neuropathy without an apathy measure.

fit: Starkstein Apathy Scale compared across Parkinson imaging clusters
assessment: The three imaging clusters have apathy means 15.11, 11.60 and 11.29 versus 8.38 in healthy controls, four-group p=.003. Group membership was defined by imaging features. No dates or intervention were tested.
